references.text: The original instruction for the curtain pillars with their copper bases, hooks, and silver crossbars, describing the same work carried out in Exodus 38:17.
Parallel text stating that all the pillars around the courtyard were to have silver crossbars, copper bases, and silver hooks.
Description of pillars with copper bases, showing the same construction pattern used in the tabernacle.
Earlier verses in the same chapter describing the courtyard pillars and their copper bases, silver hooks, and crossbars.
Continuation of the description with four pillars, their copper bases, silver hooks, and overlays on the tops.
The specific instruction for the south side that highlights the accuracy of the general summary.
The contrast between the gold-covered gate pillars and the silver/bronze pillars in the rest of the courtyard emphasizes gradual holiness.
The instruction for the north side confirming a uniform standard throughout the entire courtyard.
